[constr_2000] Compatibility of ClientServerOperations triggering the same
RunnableEntity ⌈The ClientServerOperations are considered compatible if
the number of arguments (which can be ArgumentDataPrototypes or related Port
DefinedArgumentValues) is equal and the corresponding arguments (i.e. ﬁrst ar-
gument on both sides, second argument on both sides, etc.) are compatible.

• for combinations of ArgumentDataPrototypes and ArgumentDataProto-
types where the serverArgumentImplPolicy is set to useArgumentType
the referred ImplementationDataTypes shall be compatible.
